🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 20, 2026

Moon, in Aquarius, holds a square to Mercury, in Scorpio. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Saturn and Neptune have just closed a conjunction, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Aquarius makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal fire: the opening move is the cheap one. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Aquarius: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Moon trines you from Aquarius, and the ease asks its own attention. Air adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Mercury has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is a stranger in Aquarius: neither strong nor weak. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water that starts things, started cheaply. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you from Libra, where it stands lowest. From Aquarius, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Sun has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Venus in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. A week ago Mercury was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Aquarius, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Air moves first here, and first is enough. The square to Mars that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Mercury is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. The Cancer chapter closed four weeks ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Aquarius, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Scorpio, Mercury hands you an opening. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. The same angle for two weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed air: the holding and the held stop differing. The opposition of two weeks ago is off it now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Mercury in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.
